# `cycle-class` commands

## `cycle-class activate`

Make an inactive cycle class available again.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | item |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/cycle-class.activate` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow cycle-class activate D --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Back in use" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "cycle-class activate", "input": {"cycle_class": "D"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cycle_class` | `CYCLE_CLASS` | string | yes | no | — | Class id or name.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | — |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--dry-run` | Validate and preview without writing. |
| `--reason TEXT` | Short reason for the write. |
| `--source-ref TEXT` | Identifier of the source that triggered the write. |
| `--interactive` | Prompt for input fields not supplied as arguments or options. |
| `--directive TEXT` | Standing-instruction code or id cited by the write. |
| `--idempotency-key TEXT` | Retry-safe key for this create command. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/cycle-class.activate`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |

## `cycle-class create`

Add a cycle-count class: a name and how many days may pass between counts of an item in it at a site. The company starts with A (30 days), B (90) and C (365), stored by the first write that needs them. Example: `bookflow cycle-class create --name D --interval-days 730`.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | item |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/cycle-class.create` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

## `cycle-class update`

Rename a cycle class or change its interval; items in it fall due by the new interval.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | item |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/cycle-class.update` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow cycle-class update A --interval-days 28 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Count fast movers every four weeks" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "cycle-class update", "input": {"cycle_class": "A", "interval_days": 28}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cycle_class` | `CYCLE_CLASS` | string | yes | no | — | Class id or name.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `name` | `--name` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `interval_days` | `--interval-days` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `description` | `--description` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--dry-run` | Validate and preview without writing. |
| `--reason TEXT` | Short reason for the write. |
| `--source-ref TEXT` | Identifier of the source that triggered the write. |
| `--interactive` | Prompt for input fields not supplied as arguments or options. |
| `--directive TEXT` | Standing-instruction code or id cited by the write. |
| `--idempotency-key TEXT` | Retry-safe key for this create command. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/cycle-class.update`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |
| `X-Bookflow-Reason` | conditional | Short reason; an agent or system write needs this or an active directive |
| `X-Bookflow-Source-Ref` | optional | Identifier of the source that triggered the write |
| `X-Bookflow-Directive` | conditional | Active directive code or id; alternative to reason for an agent or system write |
| `Idempotency-Key` | optional | Retry-safe key for this create command |

### Output

| JSON field | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `version` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `name` | string | yes | no | — | — |
| `interval_days` | integer | yes | no | — | — |
| `description` | string \| null | yes | yes | — | — |
| `active` | boolean | yes | no | — | — |
| `item_count` | integer | no | no | 0 | Active items in the class. |
| `changed` | boolean | no | no | true | — |

Example JSON output:

```json
{
  "active": false,
  "changed": true,
  "description": null,
  "id": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV",
  "interval_days": 1,
  "item_count": 0,
  "name": "value",
  "version": 1
}
```
